name: El Tiemblo (Spain)
description: Blue field with a green mountain rising from the base, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of El Tiemblo (two oval shields on an ornate cartouche).
history: The arms and the flag were approved by decree of 17 July 1995 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 150 of 7 August 1995); the flag is described as rectangular, one metre at the hoist and two metres in the fly, blue with a green mountain.

features.role: El Tiemblo arms — two oval shields on a cartouche
